brief:
The Shehab Wire news agency reports that Gaza continues to suffer widespread casualties and destruction, with lives being lost as military operations persist. The reporting describes the territory as wounded and bleeding heavily, with ongoing attacks characterized as displays of force against the civilian population.

The agency's account suggests international observers remain distant from the crisis unfolding in Gaza, framing the situation as one in which the territory faces both physical devastation and threats to human dignity.

title: Gaza bleeds as world watches from afar, Shehab reports
